title: Python return value discussion
summary: A short conversation about the difference between printed output and returned values in Python functions.

messages.content: 为什么 Python 函数打印了结果，但我后面不能继续使用这个结果？
因为 print 只是把内容显示到屏幕上。若后面的代码还要使用结果，函数需要用 return 把值交回给调用者。
So print is for showing something, and return is for passing the value back?
Yes. Use print() when you only want to display something. Use return when the caller needs to store, compare, or reuse the result.
